seed: Objects of type `marker` under action ACTION6 with touching neighbours [hit,wall] show mixed outcomes: gone x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Blocks (colour 10) move together: A1/A2 up/down by 4, A3 apart, A4 together (mirrored x).
Click an inactive marker (9) to arm: blocks turn colour 1, clicked marker turns 11, old active turns 9. Click a player (1) to disarm. Any other click is a no-op.
Armed: A1-A4 move the active marker by 4. A move happens only if every destination cell outside the mover is floor colour 5.
HUD: colour-0 bars on rows 0 and 63, width 3(n+1)//7. n is a hidden action counter gated on frame continuity; fallback is the smallest n that fits the shown width.
The A6 hint (gone vs no_change) is decided by the clicked cell colour: 9 arms/switches, other colours do nothing. Unconfirmed: bounds of unseen layouts.
